overview_description.description: Umrahme is a leading online travel and pilgrimage platform specializing in customized Umrah packages, visa processing, hotel bookings, flights, transportation, and travel assistance. Serving travelers globally, the company combines technology with personalized services to simplify religious journeys, offering convenient, affordable, and seamless pilgrimage experiences for individuals, families, and groups.

about_short_description.short_description: Umrahme is a digital booking platform for customized pilgrimage packages, visas, hotels, flights, and transportation services globally.

product.name: Umrah Packages
product.description: Comprehensive travel packages for Umrah pilgrimage, including accommodation, flights, transfers, and Ziarah experiences, available in Standard, Premium, and Luxury options.

product.name: Accommodation
product.description: A selection of hotels in Makkah and Madinah, ranging from 3-star to 5-star, tailored to meet various budget and comfort preferences.

product.name: Transportation
product.description: Various transportation options including airport transfers, intercity transfers, and local transfers with a fleet of sedans, SUVs, vans, and buses.

product.name: Visa Services
product.description: Support for obtaining Umrah visas, including assistance with documentation and application processes.

product.name: Umrahme Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application for planning and booking Umrah trips, offering real-time updates, support, and exclusive offers.

product.name: Tours and Activities
product.description: Curated tours and activities in Makkah, Madinah, and other significant locations, including historical and cultural sites.
